body:
Founder asked directly 'are we doing reward discounting in some way?', citing Hyperbot's own real half-life-over-real-time draw-penalty discounting technique. Checked answer: no -- only SB3 PPO's plain default gamma=0.99 per env.step(), not per real elapsed second, and the flat REWARD_LOSS-on-timeout had no mechanism making standing still costlier than engaging as the deadline approached, so a policy with a judged-low win chance had no reason to ever stop stalling for the whole match. New time_pressure_multiplier() reproduces Hyperbot's own half-life formula as reward shaping (SB3 PPO's stock GAE buffer has no hook for literal per-transition wall-clock-dependent gamma), scaling the existing S442 inactivity penalty up as the real match clock runs down -- ~0.30x severity at match start, ~0.90x with a proportionally-scaled 21s left, full ceiling at the buzzer. TIME_PRESSURE_HALF_LIFE_SECONDS is a ratio-preserving port of Hyperbot's own 139s/240s onto BRAWLPIT's own 150s cap. 9 new tests verify Hyperbot's own cited numbers directly. 72/72 tests pass. Commit f1fbf5e.

⚓ ☃
title: S449: Hyperbot-style real-time discounting on the inactivity penalty
